title: Skin Cancer Prevention
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to skin cancer prevention.
reading_level: Intermediate - Suitable for informed consumers and healthcare professionals
related_modules: DIS-034 - Ultraviolet Radiation and Skin Health
evidence_strength: Established evidence from epidemiological studies, clinical trials, and expert guidelines supports sun protection and screening for skin cancer prevention. Emerging evidence investigates chemopreventive agents and improved detection technologies. Some areas, like optimal screening intervals, have moderate evidence. Scientific consensus affirms the importance of UV protection in reducing skin cancer burden.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
